achievements.text: Team Lead · React Js & Next Js · Bit2Byte KUET

experience.title: Software Engineer I
experience.description: Working on the frontend engineering team, building and maintaining high-traffic consumer-facing web applications using React.js and Next.js. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver performant, accessible UI features at scale. Contributing to CI/CD workflows and ensuring robust deployment pipelines for production releases.
experience.detailed_desc_html:
FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE
Architected and scaled data-intensive dashboard systems using React — reusable component libraries and configuration-driven UIs across 20+ pages.
Designed dynamic UIs for campaigns, onboarding portals, and financial tools — improving extensibility and reducing development time.
STATE MANAGEMENT & DATA FLOW
Managed complex client-side state using hooks, context, and controlled forms for multi-step workflows and real-time updates.
Integrated frontend with real-time backend services — ensuring data consistency and minimizing unnecessary re-renders.
PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION
Resolved critical UI bottlenecks using memoization and state isolation — improving responsiveness for high-volume users by ~40%.
Optimized map-heavy interfaces (geofencing, markers, animations) and improved perceived latency with skeletons and async feedback patterns.
PRODUCT & FEATURE ENGINEERING
Delivered features including surge pricing, zonal promotions, and campaign lifecycle tools powering logistics, rides, and financial operations.
Built a microservice for real-time parcel data with low-latency caching across the logistics and ride ecosystem.
UX & ACCESSIBILITY
Redesigned critical workflows with validation, structured inputs, and real-time feedback — reducing operational errors.
Implemented multi-language support (Bengali · English · Nepali) for broader accessibility.
DEVOPS & DEPLOYMENT
Containerized apps with Docker, eliminating environment inconsistencies and cutting onboarding time significantly.
Strengthened CI/CD pipelines, led production deployments, and resolved critical performance issues for high-volume users.
BEYOND CORE
Maintained a centralized engineering knowledge base covering CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, and deployment workflows.
Built automation scripts and reusable CI templates — standardizing workflows and improving developer onboarding experience.

projects.name: Postbox
projects.desc: A browser-based Postman alternative featuring collection management, HTTP request building, and full request history — all persisted in localStorage. Supports keyboard shortcuts for power-user workflows and enforces code quality via Husky pre-commit hooks.

projects.name: DomiKnows
projects.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Supabase · Gemini API · RAG
projects.desc: A personal productivity playground that visualizes Markdown notes fetched directly from a GitHub repository, with session storage caching to gracefully handle GitHub rate limits. Also build a chatbot using RAG with Gemini API.

projects.name: BanglaHire
projects.desc: A full-stack Bangladeshi freelance marketplace featuring secure JWT-based authentication, dynamic job listings, proposal management, and role-based dashboards for clients and freelancers.

projects.name: Blog – Bit2Byte
projects.desc: Official blog and knowledge-sharing platform for Bit2Byte, KUET's reputed software engineering club. Features article publishing, member profiles, and event announcements with a Next.js frontend backed by a Spring Boot REST API.

projects.name: FileDrive
projects.desc: A secure cloud file storage system with role-based access control, robust authentication, and organized file management — built with a Laravel REST API and a React frontend.

projects.name: BioLock
projects.desc: An IoT-integrated security system bridging hardware and software — an Arduino-connected frontend communicates with a JWT-secured Express backend, with Twilio handling real-time SMS alerts for access events.

projects.name: Salami – Web3
projects.desc: A Web3 micro-payment DApp that lets users register and send crypto tips to peers via MetaMask. Built with Hardhat for smart contract development and Ethers.js for blockchain interaction.
